name: Vintage Bait
description: Your grandfather’s grandfather probably used this bait, and the fish still love it. Can’t go wrong with a classic.
notes: Using Vintage Bait removes items from the loot table, only allowing you to catch creatures. Resembles the Legacy Fishing Bait.

name: Weighted Bait
description: I like big fishes and I cannot lie, all the other fisherman cannot deny, when you drop a weighted bait, and the board starts to shake, you get PUMPED!
notes: Increases the average weight of catches.

name: Golden Bait
description: Money, gold, it’s just throw gold in the water in a desperate attempt for high quality fish. No big deal.
notes: Increases the chance to catch a high-quality fish. Is used when a high-quality fish is caught.

name: Money Bait
description: You can never have enough money, unless the IRS is asking… in which case, what money?
notes: Sells your creatures instantly instead of sending them to your bucket, for both coins and tokens. Used when a creature is caught.

name: Lucky Bait
description: Normally people put lucky charms in their pockets but this works too. Anything for a luck boost, am I right?
notes: Increases luck when fishing, so that you can get rarer variants. Used when any creature is caught, not used when finding bait.

name: Timely Bait
description: A fish is never late or early, but precisely on time.
notes: Each fish has specific UTC hours when they can be caught, but using this bait removes that limit. Creatures that need a specific time can bypass this.

name: Magnet Bait
description: Who needs fish when you can collect treasure?
notes: Removes creatures from the item pool so you can only get items.

name: XP Bait
description: Nothing tastes better than leveling up!
notes: Gives 3x season pass XP on any catch and gives 2x points for regular Dank Member levels. Used when any season pass XP is gained from fishing.

name: Eyeball Bait
description: This bait only has an eye for the really valuable fish. Wait... why is it looking at me like that?
notes: Heavily increases the odds of catching a unique variant or chroma fish.

name: Ghastly Bait
description: Halloween isn't just a season, it's a way of life! If this bait doesn't lure some spooky stuff your way, nothing will.
notes: Adds a chance to get Halloween-themed items while fishing! Used when a Halloween item is caught.

name: Deadly Bait
description: This was used to catch a monster. Now, the monster uses it.
notes: Increases the chances of catching bosses by 2x and high-quality bosses by 2x. (This is still a painfully low amount)

name: Turkey Bait
description: No one tell Momma we used her cooking for bait, or the Thanksgiving fish you catch won't be the only thing getting filleted!
notes: Allows you to catch the limited time Turkeyfish creature which gives you more XP and can be found anywhere.

name: Gift Bait
description: I'm just glad I got the Naboo Swamp and Gungan Sub Lego set I asked for.
notes: Similar to Ghastly Bait, but allows a chance to get winter-themed fish when caught. Used when a Christmas fish is caught. Winter items, like Snowballs, can also be caught with this bait.
